# Data access and volume (AP-DAT)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-DAT-01

**Materialize, then query** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** Calling ToList() before Where/Skip/Take/OrderBy/Count loads the whole table into memory.

**Fix.** Compose the query on IQueryable and materialize last.

**Bad:**

```razor
db.Customers.ToList().Where(c => c.City == city).Skip(skip)
```

**Good:**

```razor
db.Customers.Where(c => c.City == city).Skip(skip).Take(take).ToListAsync(ct)
```

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `\.ToList(Async)?\s*\(\s*[^()]*\)\s*\)?\s*\.\s*(Where|Skip|Take|OrderBy|OrderByDescending|Count|Any)\s*\(`; test files excluded.

## AP-DAT-02

**Loading everything in a component** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** GetAll-style calls from components assume a small dataset.

**Fix.** Use a paged/filtered query; if the set is bounded, waive with the bound.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `await\s+[\w.]+\.(GetAll|ListAll|LoadAll)\w*\s*\(`.

## AP-DAT-03

**Client-side aggregation of large data** — severity **major**, manual review (G7), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** Summing or grouping raw rows in the browser for dashboards is slow and leaks detail data.

**Fix.** Aggregate on the server and return only the metrics.
